column6: This promotes the reflective route of lexicon-catalog-coverage-20261107a/probe/SharedLexiconCatalogWarmLookupProbe.java, which stays as that record's evidence. For open() and openLazy(), the test checks that the private payloads field is a Map and still empty. It then replaces the field with a typed counting ConcurrentHashMap<SourceIdentity, M3PrecomputePayload> that counts entries into computeIfAbsent and runs of the loader function, as the crate harness M3PayloadWarmLookupRedTest (blob b4adae54a464) did. It runs 1 cold and 100 warm lookups: every lookup must return the cached instance, the catalog must cache through the swapped map, compute_if_absent_calls must be 1 and loader_runs must be 1. Mutant mutB (L356-357 removed): AssertionError check 7 compute_if_absent_calls=101 in all 4 VM modes, in 50/50 repeated runs, and on the module path with --add-opens. Without --add-opens on the module path, the test fails with InaccessibleObjectException, so the flag is required. Production code and module-info are unchanged
